purpose: Teach: に当たって/満たし/満たさ/遂げ/併せ/略し/測っ/揃える

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、事業に当たって、いつも誠実だったぞ
lines.en: Your father was always sincere in his work.
lines.style: Gentle, measured cadence. The voice of memory—not nostalgia, but clear-eyed respect. Slight pause before the final word, as if offering it as testimony. Steady, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは品質を満たしておられました
lines.en: Yes. He upheld his standards without compromise.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Not echoing—matching the elder's tone with his own steadiness. The words land with quiet weight. Respectful, direct, no embellishment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、規定を満たさない仕事を断ったぞ
lines.en: He refused work that didn't meet his standards.
lines.style: Slower, reflective. The faintest note of wistfulness—not sadness, but the weight of a choice remembered. Emphasis on the refusal itself, like that choice still matters now.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは夢を遂げられました
lines.en: Yes. He lived to see his vision realized.
lines.style: Softer than before. A pause before the final clause—allowing the weight of that achievement to settle. Humble, not boastful. The voice of someone who understands the magnitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、各社の意見を併せてお決めだった
lines.en: He made decisions by listening to everyone—all sides.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate. Slight emphasis on the gathering of opinions, like he's describing a process of care. Wistful but not sad—this is how things were done. Small trailing-off on the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが屋号を略した話、伺っております
lines.en: Yes. I've heard how he chose the company name with such care.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost gentle. A small acknowledgment that even small choices carried his philosophy. Not proud—just steady recognition. Warm undertone of connection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界の風を測っておられたぞ
lines.en: He understood the currents of the industry—read them like the wind.
lines.style: Reflective, almost poetic in its restraint. Slow, deliberate pacing. The metaphor sits lightly—observation, not ornament. Faint admiration underneath the stillness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが社員を揃えるお気持ち、引き継いでおります
lines.en: Yes. I carry forward the care he put into building his team.
lines.style: Final statement—warm but not emotional. Conviction without performance. A quiet promise kept. Slight elongation on the final word, like a closing door shutting carefully, respectfully.
